meanings.note: Russian determiner/pronoun ('all') agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun phrase it specifies.

examples.text: Он отвечает за всю работу кухни.
examples.trans: He is responsible for all the kitchen work.

examples.text: Прошу всех любить и жаловать его.
examples.trans: I ask everyone to welcome and respect him.

examples.text: Давайте все быстро вернёмся к работе.
examples.trans: Let's all quickly return to work.

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'myself', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Лёва, давай я сам всё разгружу.
examples.trans: Lyova, let me unload everything myself.

examples.text: Тимур, этот краб точно настоящий королевский?
examples.trans: Timur, is this crab definitely a real royal one?
